method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: list_doc_pages
tools.title: List All Docs Pages
tools.description: List all available documentation page slugs. Returns an array of slug paths that can be used with get_doc_page.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Get the markdown content of a specific documentation page by its slug path (e.g., "developers/quickstart", "developers/models").

language.description: Programming language(s) for code examples, comma-separated (e.g. "python", "javascript", "curl"). Add an SDK subtag to pin one SDK ("python-xai", "python-openai", "javascript-ai-sdk", "javascript-openai"). Only matching variants of multi-language examples are returned; omit for all languages.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search across all SpaceXSI documentation pages for a keyword or phrase. Returns matching page slugs with relevant excerpts.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: Get the full llms.txt content — all SpaceXSI documentation pages concatenated into a single text file. This is a large payload; prefer get_doc_page for specific pages, or pass `language` to drop code examples in other languages.

language.description: Programming language(s) for code examples, comma-separated (e.g. "python", "javascript", "curl"). Only matching variants of multi-language examples are returned; omit for all languages. SDK subtags are honoured at language granularity here (e.g. "python-openai" returns every Python variant) — use get_doc_page to pin one SDK.
